page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes 35 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1d cache. The CPU supports AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA instruction sets, though it lacks newer extensions such as AVX-512 VNNI, AVX VNNI, and AMX.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.se1ne.large demonstrates entry-level performance across compute and memory subsystems. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated as weak, falling into the bottom 25%, while the multi-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 10% with a score of 1459.48. Memory bandwidth tests show poor throughput, with read-only large block operations measuring 10.38 GB/sec and write large block operations at 9.23 GB/sec. Similarly, database and key-value operations, such as Redis SET, reach 1.37 million operations per second, which is in the bottom 10% of tested instances.

The instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware profile is structured for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high CPU throughput. This configuration is suitable for small-scale caching layers, lightweight database operations, and memory-optimized utility tasks where memory capacity is prioritized over raw computational speed or high-speed local storage.
